proofs.text: Run `--gate tested` on a project with no spec and verify the last line starts with the arrow and names `purlin:spec`; write one spec, run again and verify the last line still starts with the arrow

reasons: PROOF-34 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: The last line of a run is the next step, computed from the state the project is now in

tests.body:
def test_the_next_step_is_the_last_line(self, project):
        lines = project.run('--gate', 'tested').strip().splitlines()
        assert lines[-1].startswith('→')
        assert 'purlin:spec' in lines[-1]
